resource.ask: VISA resource of the power meter (USBTMC; the serial number is on the label on the back)
resource.help: Thorlabs vendor id is 0x1313; product ids: 0x8078 PM100D, 0x8079 PM100A, 0x8072 PM100USB, 0x8075 PM400 (unverified for the PM400). pyvisa with pyvisa-py and pyusb lists it as USB0::0x1313::0x8078::<serial>::INSTR. TCPIP0::<ip>::inst0::INSTR works only on meters with a LAN port (PM5020); tcp://host:5025 likewise. With pyvisa not installed, type the string.
